title: Sliding window over Swift characters
summary: Traverse text as Characters and track last-seen positions to find a longest substring without repeats.
triggers: longest contiguous stretch with no repeated character
longest substring with no duplicates using last-seen indices
prompts: Find the longest run of distinct displayed characters, including emoji.
A playlist may not repeat a song within a block. Find the longest existing block that obeys the rule.
invariant: The inclusive window from left to right contains no repeated Character.
mantra: Expand right; jump left past repeats; never move left backwards.
pitfalls: Without max, an old sighting before the window can move left backwards.
enumerated provides traversal offsets, not String.Index values.
test: if Set(slice).count == slice.count { expected = max(expected, slice.count) }

complexity.time: O(n) expected in characters, excluding variable Unicode hashing costs

anchors.name: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
anchors.trick: Jump left past the repeated character without ever moving left backwards.
